mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.course_code, c.course_name, c.credit, c.course_category, c.description, c.total_hours, c.teacher_id, u.name as teacher_name, c.course_status, c.semester, c.start_date, c.end_date FROM class_students cs JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN class_courses cc_c ON cc.id = cc_c.class_id LEFT JOIN courses c ON (cc_c.course_id = c.id OR (cc_c.course_id IS NULL AND cc.course_id = c.id)) LEFT JOIN users u ON (c.teacher_id = u.id OR (cc_c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL AND cc_c.teacher_id = u.id)) WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND c.id IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT IFNULL(AVG(score), 0) FROM ( SELECT asub.score FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND asub.score IS NOT NULL AND CAST(asub.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH)
UNION ALL SELECT es.score FROM exam_submissions es JOIN exams e ON es.exam_id = e.id WHERE es.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND es.score IS NOT NULL AND CAST(es.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH)
) AS scoped_scores ), 0 ) AS averageScore, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.id NOT IN ( SELECT assignment_id FROM assignment_submissions WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ) ) AS pendingAssignments, CASE WHEN ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments WHERE course_id = #{courseId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exams WHERE course_id = #{courseId}) ) > 0 THEN ROUND( ( COALESCE( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId}
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH)
), 0 ) + COALESCE( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_submissions es JOIN exams e ON es.exam_id = e.id WHERE es.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId}
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH)
), 0 ) ) * 100.0 / ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments WHERE course_id = #{courseId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exams WHERE course_id = #{courseId}) ), 0 ) ELSE 0 END AS overallProgress FROM dual

SELECT CASE WHEN (total_tasks > 0) THEN ROUND((completed_tasks / total_tasks) * 100, 0) ELSE 0 END AS progress FROM ( SELECT -- 统计课程的作业数（通过assignment_classes表关联，只统计学生所在班级的作业） (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.student_id = #{studentId}) AS total_assignments, -- 统计已完成的作业数 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT asub.assignment_id) FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND asub.student_id = #{studentId}) AS completed_assignments, -- 统计课程的考试数（通过exam_classes表关联，只统计学生所在班级的考试） (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM exams e JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.student_id = #{studentId}) AS total_exams, -- 统计已完成的考试数 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT es.exam_id) FROM exam_submissions es JOIN exams e ON es.exam_id = e.id JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND es.student_id = #{studentId}) AS completed_exams, -- 计算总任务数 ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.student_id = #{studentId}) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM exams e JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.student_id = #{studentId})) AS total_tasks, -- 计算已完成任务数 ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT asub.assignment_id) FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND asub.student_id = #{studentId}) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT es.exam_id) FROM exam_submissions es JOIN exams e ON es.exam_id = e.id JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND es.student_id = #{studentId})) AS completed_tasks FROM dual ) AS task_stats

SELECT a.id AS id, c.course_name AS course, c.course_name AS courseName, 'assignment' AS type, a.title AS name, a.title AS examName, a.due_date AS examDate, asub.score AS score, 100 AS total, asub.submission_date AS submitDate, CASE WHEN asub.graded THEN 'graded' ELSE 'submitted' END AS status, cs.class_id AS classId, ( SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM assignment_submissions asub2 WHERE asub2.assignment_id = a.id AND asub2.score > asub.score AND CAST(asub2.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1 AND asub2.student_id IN ( SELECT cs2.student_id FROM class_students cs2 WHERE cs2.class_id = cs.class_id ) ) AS `rank` FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN courses c ON a.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN assignment_submissions asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id AND cs.student_id = asub.student_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND asub.score IS NOT NULL AND CAST(asub.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1
AND c.semester = #{semester}
AND c.id = #{courseId}
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND c.semester = (SELECT semester FROM courses WHERE id = #{courseId} LIMIT 1)
UNION
SELECT e.id AS id, c.course_name AS course, c.course_name AS courseName, 'exam' AS type, e.title AS name, e.title AS examName, e.start_time AS examDate, es.score AS score, 100 AS total, es.submission_date AS submitDate, CASE WHEN es.graded THEN 'graded' ELSE 'submitted' END AS status, cs.class_id AS classId, ( SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM exam_submissions es2 WHERE es2.exam_id = e.id AND es2.score > es.score AND CAST(es2.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1 AND es2.student_id IN ( SELECT cs2.student_id FROM class_students cs2 WHERE cs2.class_id = cs.class_id ) ) AS `rank` FROM exams e JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN exam_submissions es ON e.id = es.exam_id AND cs.student_id = es.student_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND es.score IS NOT NULL AND CAST(es.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1
AND c.semester = #{semester}
AND c.id = #{courseId}
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
AND c.semester = (SELECT semester FROM courses WHERE id = #{courseId} LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY submitDate DESC

SELECT -- 使用预先计算的week_index，避免ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY问题 CONCAT('第', WEEK(current_date()) - week_index + 1, '周') AS week, SUM(completed) AS completed_tasks, SUM(total) AS total_tasks, CASE WHEN SUM(total) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(completed) / SUM(total)) * 100, 0) ELSE 0 END AS progress FROM (
SELECT a.id, a.course_id, DATE(a.due_date) AS week_ending, asub.submission_date AS submit_date, -- 以提交时间为主、截止时间为辅计算周索引 WEEK(COALESCE(asub.submission_date, a.due_date)) AS week_index, CASE WHEN asub.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed, 1 AS total FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id LEFT JOIN assignment_submissions asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id AND cs.student_id = asub.student_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.due_date >= DATE_SUB(current_date(), INTERVAL 5 WEEK)
UNION ALL
SELECT e.id, e.course_id, DATE(e.end_time) AS week_ending, es.submission_date AS submit_date, -- 以提交时间为主、考试结束时间为辅计算周索引 WEEK(COALESCE(es.submission_date, e.end_time)) AS week_index, CASE WHEN es.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed, 1 AS total FROM exams e JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id LEFT JOIN exam_submissions es ON e.id = es.exam_id AND cs.student_id = es.student_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.end_time >= DATE_SUB(current_date(), INTERVAL 5 WEEK) ) AS weekly_tasks GROUP BY week_index ORDER BY week_index DESC LIMIT 5

choose.when:
SELECT CONCAT('第', week_index, '周') AS date, CONCAT('第', week_index, '周') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(sa.study_time), 0) AS study_time FROM (
SELECT 4 - n AS week_index, DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL n WEEK) AS week_start_date, YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL n WEEK)) AS year_num, WEEK(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL n WEEK), 1) AS week_num FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 ) AS numbers ) AS d LEFT JOIN (
SELECT YEAR(asub.submission_date) AS year_num, WEEK(asub.submission_date, 1) AS week_num, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS study_time FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.id WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
AND c.semester = #{semester}
AND c.id = #{courseId}
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY YEAR(asub.submission_date), WEEK(asub.submission_date, 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT YEAR(es.submission_date) AS year_num, WEEK(es.submission_date, 1) AS week_num, LEAST(SUM( CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.duration, 120) > 1000000000 THEN COALESCE(e.duration, 7200000000000) / 3600000000000.0 ELSE COALESCE(e.duration, 120) / 60.0 END ), 56) AS study_time FROM exam_submissions es JOIN exams e ON es.exam_id = e.id JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.id WHERE es.student_id = #{studentId} AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK)
AND c.semester = #{semester}
AND c.id = #{courseId}
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY YEAR(es.submission_date), WEEK(es.submission_date, 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT YEAR(km.last_assessed_date) AS year_num, WEEK(km.last_assessed_date, 1) AS week_num, LEAST(COUNT(*) * 0.5, 56) AS study_time FROM knowledge_mastery km WHERE km.student_id = #{studentId} AND km.last_assessed_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK) GROUP BY YEAR(km.last_assessed_date), WEEK(km.last_assessed_date, 1) ) AS sa ON d.year_num = sa.year_num AND d.week_num = sa.week_num GROUP BY d.week_index ORDER BY d.week_index ASC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.activity_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(d.activity_date, '%m-%d') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(sa.study_time), 0) AS study_time FROM (
SELECT DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS activity_date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 ) AS numbers ) AS d LEFT JOIN (
SELECT DATE(asub.submission_date) AS activity_date, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS study_time FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.id WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND c.semester = #{semester}
AND c.id = #{courseId}
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY DATE(asub.submission_date)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(es.submission_date) AS activity_date, -- 将考试学习时间按小时折算（duration单位可能是分钟或微秒），并限制在合理范围内（每天最多8小时） LEAST(SUM( CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.duration, 120) > 1000000000 THEN COALESCE(e.duration, 7200000000000) / 3600000000000.0 ELSE COALESCE(e.duration, 120) / 60.0 END ), 8) AS study_time FROM exam_submissions es JOIN exams e ON es.exam_id = e.id JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.id WHERE es.student_id = #{studentId} AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
AND c.semester = #{semester}
AND c.id = #{courseId}
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND es.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY DATE(es.submission_date)
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE(km.last_assessed_date) AS activity_date, -- 知识点学习时间同样限制每日上限，避免异常数据 LEAST(COUNT(*) * 0.5, 8) AS study_time FROM knowledge_mastery km WHERE km.student_id = #{studentId} AND km.last_assessed_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(km.last_assessed_date) ) AS sa ON d.activity_date = sa.activity_date GROUP BY d.activity_date ORDER BY d.activity_date

mapper.select:
SELECT -- 课程统计 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cc.course_id) FROM class_students cs JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId}) AS courseCount,
-- 平均成绩：优先使用手工维护值，缺失时回退到动态计算（使用真实成绩） COALESCE( sp.average_score, (SELECT IFNULL(AVG(score), 0) FROM ( SELECT score FROM assignment_submissions WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND score IS NOT NULL AND CAST(graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT score FROM exam_submissions WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND score IS NOT NULL AND CAST(graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1 ) AS all_scores) ) AS averageScore,
-- 待交作业：始终使用动态计算，确保数据实时准确 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.id NOT IN (SELECT assignment_id FROM assignment_submissions WHERE student_id = #{studentId})) AS pendingAssignments,
-- 考试统计（与前端一致：按开始时间>当前时间统计“即将到来”的考试） (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM exams e JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.start_time > NOW() ) AS upcomingExams,
-- 学习进度：优先使用手工维护值，缺失时回退到动态计算 COALESCE( sp.overall_progress, IFNULL( ( -- 计算作业和考试的总完成率 SELECT CASE WHEN (total_assignments + total_exams) > 0 THEN ROUND((completed_assignments + completed_exams) / (total_assignments + total_exams) * 100, 0) ELSE 0 END FROM ( -- 统计总作业数和已完成作业数（通过assignment_classes表关联） SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_classes ac ON a.id = ac.assignment_id JOIN class_students cs ON ac.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId}) AS total_assignments, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT asub.assignment_id) FROM assignment_submissions asub WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND CAST(asub.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1) AS completed_assignments, -- 统计总考试数和已完成考试数（通过exam_classes表关联） (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) FROM exams e JOIN exam_classes ec ON e.id = ec.exam_id JOIN class_students cs ON ec.class_id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId}) AS total_exams, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT es.exam_id) FROM exam_submissions es WHERE es.student_id = #{studentId} AND CAST(es.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1) AS completed_exams FROM dual ) AS completion_stats ), 0 ) ) AS overallProgress FROM (SELECT 1) AS d LEFT JOIN student_performance sp ON sp.student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: INSERT INTO student_performance (student_id, average_score, pending_assignments, overall_progress, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, COALESCE(#{averageScore}, 0), COALESCE(#{pendingAssignments}, 0), COALESCE(#{overallProgress}, 0), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE average_score = VALUES(average_score), pending_assignments = VALUES(pending_assignments), overall_progress = VALUES(overall_progress), updated_at = NOW();
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO class_students (class_id, student_id) VALUES (#{classId}, #{studentId});
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT cs.student_id as studentId, c.id as courseId, c.teacher_id as teacherId FROM class_students cs JOIN course_classes cc ON cs.class_id = cc.id JOIN class_courses cc_c ON cc.id = cc_c.class_id JOIN courses c ON cc_c.course_id = c.id WHERE c.course_status = 'active' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = cs.student_id AND u.is_active = 1 )

SELECT score, submission_date as submissionDate, 'assignment' as type FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId} AND asub.graded = 1 AND asub.score IS NOT NULL AND asub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT score, submission_date as submissionDate, 'exam' as type FROM exam_submissions esub JOIN exams e ON esub.exam_id = e.id WHERE esub.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND esub.graded = 1 AND esub.score IS NOT NULL AND esub.submission_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
ORDER BY submissionDate DESC

SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_submissions esub JOIN exams e ON esub.exam_id = e.id WHERE esub.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId}), 0 ) / NULLIF( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments WHERE course_id = #{courseId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exams WHERE course_id = #{courseId}), 0 ) as completionRate,
COALESCE( DATEDIFF(NOW(), GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(submission_date) FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.course_id = #{courseId}), '1970-01-01'), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(submission_date) FROM exam_submissions esub JOIN exams e ON esub.exam_id = e.id WHERE esub.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId}), '1970-01-01') ) ), 999 ) as daysWithoutActivity

SELECT asub.score, asub.submission_date as submissionDate, 'assignment' as type FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id WHERE asub.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.course_id = ( SELECT course_id FROM knowledge_points WHERE id = #{knowledgePointId} LIMIT 1 ) AND asub.graded = 1 AND asub.score IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT esub.score, esub.submission_date as submissionDate, 'exam' as type FROM exam_submissions esub JOIN exams e ON esub.exam_id = e.id WHERE esub.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.course_id = ( SELECT course_id FROM knowledge_points WHERE id = #{knowledgePointId} LIMIT 1 ) AND esub.graded = 1 AND esub.score IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY submissionDate DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO student_knowledge_points ( student_id, knowledge_point_id, mastery_level, average_score, practice_count, last_update_time ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{knowledgePointId}, #{masteryData.masteryLevel}, #{masteryData.averageScore}, #{masteryData.practiceCount}, NOW() )
